The only guard activity recorded in the channel from that point is your 10:42 note that the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Mateo's 11:03 message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 update says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
